gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Azonix has round, wide-mouthed bowls with walls that never swell or taper, and its capitals barely clear the lowercase. Noto Sans Nabataean, a plain sans, reads easily, its tall lowercase flowing on.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-parkinsans: Azonix hits hard, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk and capitals just above the lowercase. Parkinsans takes over for reading, one stroke thickness throughout, with lowercase rising close to the capitals.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-vend-sans: Azonix packs its capitals barely above the lowercase. Vend Sans, a sans-serif, does the quiet work: a ruler-drawn line, open terminals, and an x-height filling every line, while Azonix commands attention.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-yaldevi: Azonix has no calligraphic swelling anywhere in its outlines, and its capitals sit only slightly above the lowercase, so words take a moment to knit together. Yaldevi, a sans, steps in with oversized lowercase.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-aldrich: Blockletter swells through the middle like a squat brush-pen belly. Aldrich, a plain sans, follows with lowercase near cap height and cupped round letters, tracing one thick thread beneath it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-anek-gujarati: Blockletter looks sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, a unit-width stroke from end to end. And Anek Gujarati, a plain sans, gives you lowercase rivaling the capitals; size it up a touch.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-atkinson-hyper: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono reads with open counters that breathe, though its capitals and ascenders feel clipped beside the lowercase. And Blockletter does the loud part, its strokes cut from wire, with a tall belly in the middle.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-blinker: Blockletter bulges at the middle like a squat brush-pen belly, drawn by a pencil that never presses harder. Blinker, a plain sans, holds its line thickness with open apertures; shrink the heading and that belly would clog.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic is a sans-serif with a high-set x-height. Its generous c opening makes a long page feel unhurried, while Blockletter's pen never shifts pressure or angle above it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-gafata: Blockletter draws a marker-like constant line, with a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly. Gafata handles the reading, a plain sans whose tall band of letters has short stalks above and wide-eyed lowercase e shapes.
